notes: *in no wise* is split across εἰς, μή and παντελές rather than kept whole. Rule 33 keeps the phrase whole only for the particle pair οὐ μή, which is not what stands here; taking the three tokens as one unit on *in no wise* remains defensible.
τό before παντελές is unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner for it.
